### A Theology of Grief
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-may-14-2024.html
Passage: Ruth 1:20-21
Points:
- Naomi returned to Bethlehem carrying profound grief and openly voiced her heartache rather than hiding behind a false pretense.
- Suffering and difficult providences are inescapable realities that believers must wrestle with honestly before God.
- Rather than viewing her sorrow as random misfortune, Naomi acknowledged God's sovereign hand at work in her affliction.
- Calling God "Shaddai" reflects the truth that the Almighty provides strength and care when we are at our lowest.
- Even while Naomi felt completely empty, God had arranged her return at harvest time to begin unfolding His provision and hope.
